items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire (a direction key fires, does not move); E places a bomb and decrements bomb HUD; wall hint ITEM=Space untested. HUD: hearts (3 = full), coins, bombs, keys, curse icon. Death indicator: hearts showing empty outlines plus a pale ghost sprite at top of room (seen once); later a bloodied X-eyed body at bottom center with a clean sprite above — likely death, unconfirmed.

ITEM 'TECH X' (observed): obtained twice — from a red chest in a treasure room (earlier run) and from a green/white pill floating above a rock in the two-poop room. Firing produces a laser ring ahead of the player in the fire direction; it lingers/drifts, grinds overlapping targets, then fades. CORRECTION to earlier belief: ring offset is NOT reliably ~110px — measured spawn distances ranged roughly 200–325px across attempts and seemed to vary; distance-math aim is unreliable. Sustained fire was needed to kill a blue fly. Laser is weak vs brown poop (resists); bombs broke poop piles. Purple/golden-brown poop vanished on contact for a coin. Poop piles regenerate when re-entering rooms.

CHESTS (observed): a locked-looking gray/metal chest opened by firing into it, dropping a heart (+1 heart) and a bomb orb (+1 bomb); another gray chest opened on contact after its room's blue fly died. A red treasure-room chest gave an item on contact. In the dark chest room the two corner red-lidded chests (top-left, top-right) did NOT open despite many laser hits that visibly registered (impact sparks), even when the ring landed near/on them — unresolvable yet. Earlier touching a corner chest cost several hearts in one contact (possible mimic/spike chest — guess, unconfirmed). The top-left red chest in the dark room appeared tilted/opened with black spiders beside it (whether it spawned them unconfirmed). Central red chest ringed by white spikes stayed closed to laser hits. HUD keys have consistently been 0; key-shaped floor sprites proved to be my own laser particles, not pickups.

BOMBS (observed): E places; blast damages the player — even a 0.5s left retreat from adjacent placement still cost a heart, so retreat much farther. Bombs destroyed rock rings in an earlier run; a bomb against suspicious cracked/stained right-wall patterns did nothing (likely decorative). A bomb beside the white spike ring did NOT remove any spikes; ring remained intact.

HAZARDS: black spider-like enemies in the dark chest room are melee/chasers and lethal — killed the player at 2 hearts. White round-faced enemies (probably hoppers) in the rock-field room appear dangerous; health fell from full to empty quickly there (guess: they hop/damage on contact). White spike ring around central red chest is likely damaging; it is plus/cross-shaped with gaps at the four diagonals — whether the gaps can be traversed is unresolved (never attempted). Diagonal rock chains block straight-line movement; go around.

TRANSITIONS (observed): bottom gold trapdoors descend only when standing fully centered. Top gold crown hatches warp from centered below with sustained W (needs nudging to center). Dark trapezoid doorways at top/bottom centers are ordinary connections requiring sustained walking. Right-wall doorways need the correct vertical band (tutorial room roughly y 310–400). UNRESOLVED: in the dark chest room, sustained left pushes directly beside the left-wall door marking (y~345–360, marking spans ~y330–395) failed to transition back to the tutorial room despite several attempts — either the marking is decorative, the band is narrower/different, or entry needs a pure single-axis approach. (Entry into the dark room was via the tutorial's right doorway.)

MAP RELATIONSHIPS: Tutorial room (wall hints, top and bottom trapezoid doors, right-wall doorway) — bottom door → rock-ring gray-chest room (chest inside a rock ring, bottom gold trapdoor); earlier run descending led to a red treasure-chest room (gave Tech X), then a gray-chest room with torches/rocks/poop/blue fly, then the two-poop room. Torch room (corner torches, diagonal rock chain, poop, scorch mark, top trapezoid door, bottom gold trapdoor): top door loops to tutorial; bottom trapdoor → two-poop room (central rock, two poop piles, top crown hatch). Two-poop room's crown hatch returns to torch room. Tutorial right doorway → dark chest room (two corner red chests, central spike-ringed red chest, black poop piles, black spiders). Tutorial top door → NEW rock-field room: many gray rocks, a golden chest-like object embedded in the left wall (~possibly a chest needing a key, or a door), and white round-faced hopping enemies; its other exits unconfirmed.

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact-opening a metal chest from above/below; firing while too close (ring overshoots); entering hatches/trapdoors from offset; treating floor key-sprites as pickups; bombing the spike ring; laser on the corner red chests; long sustained pushes into the left wall in the dark room; lingering near white hoppers at low health.

ACTIVE GOALS: survive and find health pickups (most cleared rooms gave none); identify/open the golden wall object in the rock-field room; figure out how to open the red-lidded corner chests or whether they are mimics; test the diagonal gaps of the white spike ring to reach the central red chest; explore untried tutorial exits.
